title: Walnut Norwegian Lasagna
description: A traditional Norwegian twist on the classic Italian dish, featuring the nutty flavor of walnuts and the sweetness of lasagna.
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a blender or food processor, combine Norwegian walnut pesto, chopped walnuts, mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese, and fresh basil. Blend until smooth.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add pesto mixture and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a thin layer of pesto mixture. Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top.
Repeat the layers, starting with noodles, then pesto mixture, and ending with a layer of mozzarella cheese.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
